messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: starting a 1% canary for the stricter invoke/schema gate today. Soft-fail mode so no hard rejects while we gather real traffic signals. Tag events with `schema.strict_canary` please.
aj: Clarify API surface: what does soft-fail return? The console today shows a hard "tool invocation rejected" which leads to support tickets.
ravi: Soft-fail = 200 OK with a `warning` field on the invoke response. Also attach a compact `reject_reason` token in telemetry. Console should show an amber notice and link to a friendly details pane, not a red error.
olivia: Telemetry needed: buckets for `reject_reason`, `sdk_version`, `route_id`, `model_variant`, `sampling_origin`. Also emit whether we coerced the payload (`coercion_applied=true/false`).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started service=invoke-gate canary=strict-schema pct=1
aj: Billing question: do these soft-fails count against customer quotas? We need a default for the canary.
maria: For canary they should NOT be billed. Add `billing_exempt=true` to traces so billing filters can ignore them. We'll revisit after 72h.
ravi: UX guidance for Console: toast text "Invoke returned a schema warning — suggested fix available" with link to a pane showing example diffs. Do NOT show raw JSON traces to customers.
aj: Example suggested_fix payload in the details pane (we can show safe coercions):
```
old: {"tool_args": {"mode": "on", "timeout": "30"}}
suggested: {"tool_args": {"mode": "on", "timeout": 30}}
```
small coercions like string->int and known enum synonyms are safe to suggest.
olivia: Emit `schema.auto_coercion=true/false` in telemetry so we can measure how often coercion would have fixed it. Also add `sample_tag` for routing.
sre-bot: alert: observed a canary spike at 5003001400 — 15 soft-fails/min for acct=acme-prod. No hard rejects.
maria: Throttle heavy tenants for canary stats. @aj can you add a per-account cap and dedupe identical payloads so one tenant doesn't dominate?
aj: Will do. Adding `per_account_cap=100/min` and a dedupe hash key in the canary config. Also wire `schema_canary_log_sample=0.05` for sampled payloads to the redaction pipeline.
ravi: Dashboard request: small tile scoped to route=invoke showing "canary soft-fails / min", top reject reasons, and impacted SDK versions. Prefer new tile but can reuse widgets.
olivia: I'll add a panel (dash id rdw/2401). Event shape: `evt_type=invoke.schema_warning`, fields: `route_id`, `reject_reason`, `sdk_version`, `coercion_applied`, `billing_exempt`, `sample_tag`.
aj: Policy Q: When we flip to enforced, should coercion be auto-enabled? I suggest coercion remains opt-in via `graceful_coercion=true` in route config.
maria: Agreed. Rollout plan: 1) 1% soft-fail (billing_exempt=true), 2) monitor 72h, 3) surface CTA in Console for customers to enable `graceful_coercion`, 4) after two weeks consider enforcing on new routes only.
aj: Action items: Add `billing_exempt` to traces and update billing filter (PR #2246). @olivia add dashboard tile rdw/2401. @ravi draft Console copy with example diffs.
ravi: Drafting copy now and will include quick SDK upgrade links and suggested fixes.
olivia: Panel created and linked: https://go/internal/dash/rdw/2401
maria: I opened an issue for canary metrics and postmortem checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/5679
sre-bot: reminder: redact PII keys (email, ssn) from sampled payload logs. Sample at 5%.
aj: Yep using existing redaction pipeline and sample rate 0.05.
maria: Thanks everyone. Revisit after 72h with aggregated numbers. If anyone spots customer impact ping #support immediately.
